samir: heads-up — running the wasm sample (sdk-wasm v0.2.0) the other day I noticed raw emails and api keys in console during the token refresh flow. seems like redactHook isn't applied for the first log before retry.

samir: repro: run examples/wasm in chrome, click 'call (expire)'. snippet: 
```
2026-08-02T10:00:01.100Z ERROR request failed user=zoe@biz.com api_key=sk-live-XYZ
2026-08-02T10:00:01.300Z INFO retry attempt=2 request_id=req-777
2026-08-02T10:00:01.450Z ERROR request failed user=[REDACTED] api_key=[REDACTED]
```

lucy: thanks — two usual suspects: redactHook async init (rules fetched remotely) and retry code generating a new request_id on each attempt which breaks correlation.

lucy: quick mitigation ideas: 1) examples: include a tiny baked-in ruleset applied synchronously on init, 2) sdk: compute attemptId once at attempt start and attach header `x-rw-attempt`, reuse for retries so later logs can be correlated, 3) patch console.* asap (include console.debug) so early logs are covered.

hana: for wasm specifically the fetch polyfill and worker threading can reorder logs; also console is shimmed by the bundler — ensure redactHook patches the shim, not only native console.

hana: also add opt-in `redactOnAllLevels` for dev builds so debug/trace are covered in samples without affecting prod perf.

samir: I'll open a tiny PR in examples/wasm to add baked-in rules and a unit test that runs the expire flow in headless chrome and asserts no email-like or sk- tokens in console output.

devx-bot: Please open GH issue with labels: devex, telemetry, security and attach logs.

pat: one more note — our retry middleware currently does `req.headers.set('x-request-id', uuid())` per attempt. Instead do `const attempt = req.headers.get('x-rw-attempt') || uuid(); req.headers.set('x-rw-attempt', attempt); if (!req.headers.get('x-request-id')) req.headers.set('x-request-id', attempt);` that keeps a stable id even when proxies rewrite x-request-id.

lucy: add tests: e2e in headless chrome to capture console, unit test that ensures `x-rw-attempt` persists across native fetch retries. Also update SDK docs about header semantics.

samir: repro env: chrome 119, node 20, sdk-wasm 0.2.0, otel-js 1.18.0. PR coming in ~1h. :thumbsup:
